description_en: Enables or disables WAF protection feature modules for a domain name, such as web tamper-proofing, legitimate crawlers, crawler threat intelligence, custom protection policies, and website whitelists
description_zh: 启用或禁用域名WAF防护功能模块，如网站防篡改、合法爬虫、爬虫威胁情报、自定义防护策略、网站白名单
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-protection-rule-status --domain www.example.com --defense-type tamperproof --rule-id 42755 --rule-status 1 --lock-version 2 --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyProtectionRuleStatus

parameters.help_en: The domain name that has been added
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The protection feature module. Valid values:

tamperproof: web tamper-proofing

bot_crawler: the legitimate search engine whitelist in the legitimate crawlers feature module

bot_intelligence: crawler threat intelligence

ac_custom: custom protection policy

whitelist: website whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
防护功能模块，取值：

tamperproof：网站防篡改

bot_crawler：合法爬虫中的合法搜索引擎白名单

bot_intelligence：爬虫威胁情报

ac_custom：自定义防护策略

whitelist：网站白名单
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html operation to query all rule IDs
parameters.help_zh:
配置规则ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html接口可以查询到所有规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the protection rule. Valid values:

0: disabled
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
配置规则状态。取值：

0：禁用
1：启用
parameters.name: rule_status

parameters.help_en: The version number of the rule configuration record
parameters.name: lock_version

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id
